detail.longDescription: I want to thank @technocounselor@caneandable.social for an incredible accessible virtual machine. Running Windows 11 on my Mac Book Pro, M4, and it runs nicely. Do away with the corporate household names that take up multiple GB of space, and go try this open source project out for yourself. Instantly hooked. https://github.com/allisonfm85/accessible-virtual-machine Check out her interview on my show,  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7XU5eLj_Lxg&t=552s #Accessibility #Productivity #VirtualMachine
